The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Γ ∈ K , let Λ be any countably infinite ICC group, and let µ ∈ Z2(Γ, T) and ω ∈ Z2(Λ, T) be normalized scalar cocycles. Every bifinite Lµ(Γ)–Lω(Λ) correspondence is unitarily isomorphic to a closed bimodule summand of a finite direct sum of the models E(A, B, δ, σ) in Equation (1.2), where A ≤ Γ and B ≤ Λ have finite index, δ : A → B is an actual group isomorphism, and σ is a finite-dimensional projective unitary representation satisfying Equation (1.1). Conversely, every such model, finite direct sum, and closed bimodule summand is a normal bifinite correspondence. If n = dimC Vσ, the elementary model has dimensions dimLµ(Γ) E(A, B, δ, σ) = n[Λ : B], dim E(A, B, δ, σ)Lω(Λ) = n[Γ : A].
